name: asset-doctor
description: Asset Doctor — multi-asset vault (React Native + Firebase)

setup: Scaffold React Native (Expo prebuild / bare RN) then copy src/ into the app.
Enable Google + Phone providers in Firebase Console → Authentication.
Configure GoogleSignin.configure({ webClientId: '<WEB_CLIENT_ID>' }) at app boot.
Add SHA-1 for Android Phone Auth / Google Sign-In.
